title: Near-black band: a small tracked label, a big ivory serif statement in up to three lines, an ivory button and a ghost button, a hairline footer row, an optional small field with a picture
use: The statement band that closes an argument or opens a section; show_tile turns the small picture on or off.

field.note: the colour field behind the picture

subject.note: which picture: 0 hand-graph, 1 seedling, 2 book, 3 magnifier, 4 spark-hands, 5 path, 6 candles, 7 compass

show_tile.note: draw the small colour field with a picture at the right

statement.default: 好的策略不是一次回测里的漂亮曲线，而是任何人拿到同一份配置都能得到同一个结论。

foot_1.default: 研究 · 回测 · 实盘

relations: Ground #0D0C0B edge to edge; label 14 bold tracked #B0AEA5 at 150 units; statement 68 serif ivory, 1.22 line height, up to three lines in 960 units (1360 without the tile); an ivory 10 unit button and a #30302E ghost button 52 high at 620.
A 1 unit #30302E hairline at 758 and a footer row of three 14 #B0AEA5 labels; the optional field is 320 square at the right with its picture at 270.
decoration: The ground, the hairline, the small field and its picture; the text slots are the only measured content.

provenance.corpus: product-site kit (examples/brand-band-site-kit): our own original one-page site in Chinese in the brand-band grammar; all copy is a placeholder
provenance.experiment: styles/brand-band/style.json provenance (public pages measured privately in Chrome on 2026-11-21; never shipped); the pictures are our own code-drawn illustrations
provenance.method: The measured near-black product hero (#0D0C0B) and the black footer (#141413) with its #B0AEA5 13 px links, merged into one statement band; the statement is the 47.8 px serif scaled up.
measured: Hero ground rgb(13,12,11), nav pills on it #262624 / #3D3D3A / #FAF9F5; footer #141413 with #B0AEA5 13 px links.
Template: three lines of 14 characters each fit; ivory on #0D0C0B is 18:1, #B0AEA5 on it 8.4:1.
